content.text:
Tomcat started.
Tomcat started.
pid 14165: catalina.base=/opt/tomcat-dienste
pid 14250: catalina.base=/opt/tomcat-anwendung
pid 14283: catalina.base=/opt/tomcat-api

observation.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
source /etc/xplanbox.env
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-anwendung/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh
sleep 5
ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.home" | awk '{print $2}' | while read p; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | grep -o "catalina.base=[^ ]*" | sed "s/^/pid $p: /"; done
